Tired of juggling fragmented AI coding tools across your desktop, browser, and terminal? 🛑

ZCode has emerged overnight as a premier, all-in-one AI coding workbench combining Electron, Web, and Terminal agents into a unified ecosystem! 🚀

It solves the fragmentation in AI-driven development by providing a unified AI coding workbench available as a native desktop application, a browser-based interface, and a powerful terminal Agent CLI. It seamlessly coordinates client apps, backend services, shared UI components, and agent runtimes into a cohesive developer experience.

Whether you are managing autonomous coding workflows locally or over SSH/WSL inside secure enterprise environments, or deploying a self-hosted web-based AI coding workbench for remote development teams, ZCode gives you complete control.

Notable Features:
💻 Multi-surface deployment supporting Electron desktop apps, local web workbenches, and terminal-based TUI/CLI agents.
🌐 Comprehensive remote development features including SSH and WSL integration via mock-CDN and SFTP asset syncing.
⚡ Unified zcode command-line interface capable of swapping between TUI, headless Web server modes, and workspace automation.
🛠️ Robust workspace management with custom provider configurations, isolated database directories, and automated third-party validation.

Gain a flexible, production-ready foundation to build, test, and run autonomous coding agents across local and remote environments without being locked into proprietary cloud tools. 

Check out the repository and drop a star to support the project:
https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode

Want to completely customize your iOS 18+ Apple Wallet cards and lock screen passcode keypad without jailbreaking your device? 

Meet AirCard, a sleek standalone macOS application that leverages the airlift AirTraffic sync exploit to push custom assets and themes straight to your iPhone from your Mac. 

Apple’s strict design limitations on the Wallet app and lock screen have locked down customization for years. AirCard solves this by allowing developers and power users to bypass those restrictions entirely, using real-time zero-hassle card detection via iPhone unified log stream analysis when you trigger Apple Pay.

Top features include:
💳 Custom Card Skins: Assign custom artwork, textures, or bank logos to Apple Pay and Wallet cards with per-card or bulk flashing support.
🔢 Lock Screen Passcode Themes (.passthm): Apply custom keypad button artwork using an interactive photo framing and seamless poster slicing engine.
🚀 Zero-Prerequisite Native App: Natively supports both Apple Silicon and Intel architectures with all necessary device-communication utilities pre-bundled.

For macOS and iOS developers, AirCard serves as a fantastic reference architecture for building zero-dependency native apps that interface with iOS devices via unified logging and mobile synchronization layers. It is a practical blueprint for wrapping low-level security exploits into a polished desktop utility with automated asset processing.

Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/Mak5er/AirCard

Transform your AI coding assistant from a simple text predictor into a disciplined, self-correcting engineering system with memory, automated planning, and security guards. 🚀

Are you tired of your AI coding assistant losing context mid-project, forgetting your rules, or generating code with security blind spots? 

Meet ECC (https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC), an agent harness operating system designed to standardize and optimize how AI coding assistants operate. It completely solves the frustrating context window and memory loss problem by introducing structured planning, automated test verification, self-review cycles, persistent memory, and reusable skills. 🧠⚙️

What makes ECC a game-changer for your workflow:
• Comprehensive Agent Ecosystem: Dozens of specialized agents built for planning, code review, build repair, and architecture.
• Extensive Reusable Skills: A massive library spanning TDD, security scanning, documentation, frontend, data, and machine learning workflows.
• Runtime Hooks & Memory Management: Enforces rules, generates session summaries, and drives continuous learning and instincts.
• AgentShield Security: Scans and protects against insecure code generation and supply-chain vulnerabilities during agent interactions.

Whether you want to strictly enforce Test-Driven Development (TDD) inside your sessions or manage persistent cross-session memory and team coding standards, ECC standardizes the entire development lifecycle loop—plan, test, implement, review, verify, remember, and improve. Stop wasting time on repetitive prompt engineering and let your AI handle complex coding tasks reliably.

🤖 What if your mobile AI copilot could read your chats and draft smart replies without ever needing root access, app hooks, or auto-sending messages? 

Meet jev-chat-jarvis—an innovative open-source mobile AI copilot that integrates LLM intelligence directly into daily messaging apps like WeChat, QQ, and X completely non-invasively!

⚡ The Problem It Solves:
Integrating AI into locked-down mobile chat apps usually requires risky hacks, root access, or app package modifications. Jarvis solves this by leveraging Android accessibility services and screen scrapers to safely read chat context, process it locally, and fill the input box while strictly leaving the final send action to you.

🔥 Key Features:
• Non-Invasive Architecture: Uses system accessibility services with ML Kit offline OCR fallback to extract chat content even from apps with obfuscated nodes or self-drawn canvases like Lark.
• Two-Phase AI Pipeline: A dedicated judgment model first evaluates intent, risk level, and urgency before a generation model drafts three sorted contextual responses.
• Strict Safety Boundaries: Relies on ACTION_SET_TEXT and clipboard fallbacks to place text into chat input fields, ensuring it never auto-sends messages or touches sensitive UI elements like transfers and red envelopes.
• Local Knowledge Base: A contact profile system injects personal notes and history into the AI prompt while keeping all your data strictly local and private.

💡 Why Android & AI Developers Love It:
Study this codebase to master advanced Android accessibility service exploitation, screen overlay management, and hybrid OCR fallback strategies for apps with locked-down UI trees. It provides a clean, modular adapter pattern for parsing chat data from arbitrary third-party apps without breaking process boundaries.

Check out the repository here:
https://github.com/jev-chat/jev-chat-jarvis
